summary: A compact, playable insertion beat with a clear progression: hesitation, forced movement, efficient unloading, then a dry joke that releases pressure without weakening the danger. The rotor-noise performance logic and military address are convincing.

performance.delivery: Get directly into Mostafa’s ear over the rotors. Hit «مِتْرِينْ» as reassurance, then snap «اِنْطّْ» as an order that leaves him no time to think.
Punch each word in time with the hand-to-hand unloading. Keep it gravelly and practical, with no wasted breath or visible panic.

lines.speaker: ADEL
issues: The mud joke is familiar, but the deadpan timing makes it useful and begins to define Adel.

performance.delivery: Call it loudly enough to beat the rotors, but do not perform the joke. Pull the trapped boot free, inspect the mud, and deliver «شُورْبَةْ» with flat disbelief.
